title: Straight to My account, and a proper missing-page screen
summary: Website links to My account no longer stop at the app's "click to continue" title screen, and a broken link now shows a clear "page not found" page.
items: My account opens directly from the website, with its own tab title.
An unknown address shows "This page wandered off" with links to Home, Help and the app, instead of the sign-in screen.
